The 2025 Ford Explorer ST 4WD blends high-performance EcoBoost power, sport-focused styling, and three-row SUV versatility into one of the most engaging family SUVs on the market. Finished in Star White Metallic Tri-Coat with Onyx Miko seating surfaces, this Explorer ST delivers bold design, advanced technology, and performance-inspired engineering that sets it apart from traditional midsize SUVs.

Powered by the 3.0L EcoBoost V6 paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and intelligent four-wheel drive, the Explorer ST delivers impressive acceleration and confident all-weather capability. Performance-tuned suspension, red performance brakes, trailer sway control, and Fords Terrain Management System help create a driving experience that balances athletic handling with everyday practicality.

With over $4,000 in factory-added options and packages, this Explorer features the Sun and Sound Package, Star White Metallic Tri-Coat paint, upgraded 21-inch aluminum wheels, BlueCruise capability, and Ford Performance hood graphics. The Sun and Sound Package adds a panoramic Vista Roof, B&O premium audio system with 14 speakers, and multicontour front seats that enhance both comfort and cabin refinement.

The ST-specific exterior design includes a black mesh grille, blackout lighting elements, quad-tip dual exhaust, skid plate accents, LED signature lighting, privacy glass, power liftgate, and heated power-folding mirrors with ST logo projection lamps. Its aggressive appearance is matched by functional performance enhancements throughout the vehicle.

Inside, the cabin features heated and ventilated front seats, heated second-row seating, power-folding third-row seats, ambient lighting, a heated leather-wrapped steering wheel with ST badging, universal garage door opener, USB-C charging throughout all three rows, and premium materials designed to elevate the driving experience.

Technology is centered around a 13.2-inch touchscreen infotainment system paired with a 12.3-inch digital instrument cluster. Additional features include wireless Apple CarPlay, wireless Android Auto, FordPass Connect, remote start, push-button start, SiriusXM with 360L, Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0, intersection assist, and a suite of advanced driver-assistance technologies.

The Ford Explorer has earned recognition from IIHS, Kelley Blue Book, and U.S. News & World Report for safety, utility, and family-friendly versatility. The Explorer ST stands out as the performance flagship of the lineup, offering sports-sedan-inspired acceleration and handling while retaining the passenger space and capability expected from a modern three-row SUV.

Few SUVs are as desirable, as capable, and as revered as the iconic Range Rover. Opulent, well-wrought, and spacious. The Range Rover wants for nothing inside.

Call Our Sales Team at 941-924-1211 for more info or to have a custom video emailed to you..Fast Out Of State Delivery Available..What the reviews say..The redesigned 2021 Tahoe has big improvements in ride comfort, technology and convenience features. The Chevrolet Tahoe has been fully redesigned. Longer, larger and more spacious than the previous Tahoe. Independent rear suspension for better handling and ride comfort. On the inside, the new Tahoe has more rear legroom, particularly for the third row. Max cargo room gets a significant boost, going from 94.7 cubic feet last year to 122.9 cubic feet with the second and third rows folded. The Tahoe also gets an independent rear suspension for the first time. As a result, the new Tahoe rides more smoothly over bumps and around turns than the old Tahoe, which had a traditional solid-axle rear suspension. Navigating city streets with the Tahoe is easy thanks to its tight turning circle and light steering. The 10-speed automatic transmission shifts promptly and unobtrusively. How comfortable is the Tahoe? The Tahoe's new independent rear suspension has cured many issues that plagued the last generation. The Tahoe's multi-zone climate control system's effectiveness does not disappoint, heating and cooling are effective for all three rows. How's the interior? The wide-opening doors offer easy access to front and rear seats, and even third-row passengers have ample headroom to get to their seats. We're fans of Chevrolet's latest touchscreen interface it offers crisp graphics, an easy-to-understand menu structure and quick response times. It also has wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility. You'll find plenty of charging ports through the cabin. Hows the storage? Thanks to the new independent rear suspension and larger overall dimensions, the new Tahoe can hold 25.5 cubic feet of stuff behind the third-row seats compared to the predecessor's 15.3 cubic feet. The maximum capacity grows to 122.9 cubic feet, larger than last year's Suburban. People expect comfort, capability and convenience with a large SUV, and the Chevrolet Tahoe delivers. Its redesigned rear suspension offers better interior space, increased cargo volume and a smoother ride over a wide variety of surfaces. In short, it does a better job at being the family workhorse.

Gold Certified and loaded with premium luxury, advanced technology, and full-size SUV capability, this 2022 Ford Expedition Limited delivers twin-turbo EcoBoost performance, expansive three-row comfort, and upscale refinement in one of the most capable family SUVs on the road today. Finished in stunning Agate Black Metallic over an Onyx leather-trimmed interior, this Expedition combines sophisticated styling, impressive towing capability, and premium amenities into a vehicle equally comfortable handling family road trips, daily commuting, long-distance travel, and active Florida lifestyles. With 54,055 miles, this Expedition represents an outstanding opportunity to own a Gold Certified full-size SUV backed by extensive Ford factory benefits.

Powered by Ford's proven 3.5L EcoBoost twin-turbocharged V6 engine paired with the advanced 10-speed automatic transmission with SelectShift capability, this Expedition delivers impressive horsepower, exceptional torque, and smooth highway performance. The EcoBoost powertrain provides effortless acceleration, strong towing confidence, and refined drivability whether navigating Tampa traffic, traveling throughout Wesley Chapel and Clearwater, or towing recreational equipment across Florida.

This particular Expedition is exceptionally well equipped with the highly desirable Equipment Group 304A package, which significantly elevates both luxury and technology. The package includes the panoramic Vista Roof, Stealth Edition Package, upgraded technology features, and premium appointments that transform this SUV into one of the most attractive and well-equipped Expeditions available.

The Stealth Edition Package gives this Expedition a distinctive and aggressive appearance. Black exterior accents, unique badging, striking 22-inch black-painted aluminum wheels, and darkened trim elements create a bold and sophisticated road presence that stands apart from traditional full-size SUVs. Combined with the Agate Black Metallic exterior, the overall appearance is sleek, athletic, and unmistakably premium.

Inside the cabin, the Limited trim delivers exceptional comfort and refinement. Leather-trimmed seating surfaces, heated and ventilated front seats, heated second-row seats, heated leather-wrapped steering wheel, ambient interior lighting, power-adjustable pedals with memory, tri-zone automatic climate control, power-folding third-row seating, and premium soft-touch materials throughout the cabin create a luxury-level ownership experience.

Passenger space remains one of the Expedition's greatest strengths. The spacious three-row configuration provides exceptional room for family members and guests while maintaining impressive cargo flexibility. Power-folding third-row seating, smart charging USB ports in all rows, numerous storage compartments, and expansive interior dimensions make this SUV ideal for vacations, sporting events, shopping trips, and everyday family life.

Technology is a major highlight throughout the vehicle. Equipped with the upgraded 15.5-inch touchscreen infotainment system, connected built-in navigation, FordPass Connect with Wi-Fi hotspot capability, SiriusXM with 360L, HD Radio, wireless charging pad, Bluetooth connectivity, and advanced voice controls, this Expedition keeps drivers and passengers connected on every journey.

The panoramic Vista Roof dramatically enhances the cabin experience by filling the interior with natural light and creating an open, spacious atmosphere for all three rows of seating.

Capability remains a defining characteristic of the Expedition. Equipped with the Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package, Class IV trailer tow preparation, trailer sway control, and advanced towing technologies, this SUV is engineered to confidently handle boats, campers, utility trailers, and recreational equipment. The EcoBoost engine's impressive torque output makes towing feel effortless.

    • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians.
